objective: Archmage Angela Dosantos at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants 30 Core of Elements.

description: Greetings, adventurer! Are you interested in some work? I pay those under my employ with insignias. These insignias can be used at the Quartermaster to purchase items of power.
All I need you to do is bring me as many core of elements as you can carry. The more the better!
You'll find them on elementals of varying shapes and sizes that exist across our world.
progress: I can only steer you in the right direction, <name>.
completion: A job well done, <name>! As promised, the INsignia is yours. Just remember, there's more WHERE that came from...
